description: The nth Riordan number. R(0) is 1, R(1) is 0, and (n+1)*R(n) = (n-1)*(2*R(n-1) + 3*R(n-2)) for n at least 2. R(4) is 3, and R(6) is 15. n runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/riordan
